DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

        

          CORE PRINCIPLE
          
Exceptional design bridges the gap between human intent and machine execution. It makes a product's affordances obvious through clear signifiers, a logical conceptual model, and instant, informative feedback. It does not force people to think or read a manual. It creates an intuitive, error-resistant environment where the user always feels in control.

          
The goal: I design so people can think less about the tool and more about the work.

    AI.SYS - DESIGNING WITH AI
    
      
      
      
    
  


  

    
DESIGNING WITH AI

    
Six rules I hold to when the product has a model inside it. AI should support human understanding and decision-making, not replace it.


    

      

        01_MAKE_AI_UNDERSTANDABLE.DAT
        
Give people a clear mental model. Show why a result appeared, how confident the system is, and what it drew on. No black boxes.

      

      

        02_KEEP_THE_HUMAN_IN_CONTROL.DAT
        
Let the model suggest options and take the repetitive work. Every decision stays reviewable and overridable. Agency is not negotiable.

      

      

        03_DESIGN_FOR_ERROR.DAT
        
Assume the model will be wrong sometimes. Make mistakes easy to spot, simple to correct, and give the interface a fallback that still works.

      

      

        04_FOCUS_ON_THE_TASK.DAT
        
Ask what problem we are helping someone solve, not where AI could be added. The technology is the means, never the brief.

      

      

        05_AI_AS_COLLABORATOR.DAT
        
People bring context, ethics, creativity and judgement. The model brings speed, pattern recognition and recall. Design the pairing, like a knowledgeable assistant who is easy to correct.

      

      

        06_INTENT_AND_TRUST.DAT
        
AI experiences are not always static or predictable. People still have to feel certain the system is moving them toward what they actually asked for.
